# Club

Internal ID: Club | Type: Club | Source: Player crafting menu | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Bone fragments x15 | Attack speed: 2.46 s (0.86 + 0.80 + 0.90) | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.4 range, 90 angle, 0.8 height, 0.3 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Club is the first one-handed club. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Unlike other one-handed clubs, it has no secondary attack.

## Upgrade information

• stat: Blunt | Quality 1: 12 | Quality 2: 18 | Quality 3: 24 | Quality 4: 30

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 100 | Quality 2: 150 | Quality 3: 200 | Quality 4: 250

• stat: Crafting | Quality 1: 6 Wood | Quality 2: 5 Bone fragments | Quality 3: 10 Bone fragments | Quality 4: 15 Bone fragments

• stat: Workbench level | Quality 1: 1 | Quality 2: 2 | Quality 3: 3 | Quality 4: 4

## Notes

• Not very effective at quality 1, as a Flint axe may be preferred. The Club becomes much stronger with upgrades, especially against Skeletons, which take 50% more damage from blunt.
